   var column = [new nlobjSearchColumn("custrecord_parent_promo",null,"GROUP")];

   ["custrecord_detail_customer","anyof","@NONE@"], 
   "AND", 
   ["custrecord_parent_promo","noneof","@NONE@"]
   ],column);

   promoprices.push({ type: "customrecord_promo_header", id: ppm[i].getValue(column[0]) });
   }
   return promoprices;
  }
